title: Fix favorites 500 on Express 5
summary: validateQuery no longer assigns to read-only req.query (Express 5). Fixes GET /favorites 500 on home after signup.
testFocus: After Render redeploy: signup → home → Network shows GET /favorites 200 (empty array), no 500 console spam.
productionChecks: Register or login → home → DevTools: /api/v1/favorites?gymId=... returns 200

deploy.backendNote: Render manual deploy required — frontend Pages alone will not fix this.
